root_cause.native_contract: Default-track CheckLimit returns 3 when track.DTS >= track.origin + ceil(duration_ms * timescale / 1000); video checks before writing a type-1 synchronous frame.
root_cause.conclusion: The harness requests one 64.064-second segment while explicitly configuring a 60-second native time limit. The key video packet at 60.06 seconds reaches that boundary; return 3 is a time-limit result rather than proof of packet corruption. The harness has no rollover handling at its unconditional zero-status assertion.
